title: Uneventful
body: I haven't found a flow yet. I'm hovering around so many ideas and have trouble deciding which is the way forward.
One thing I have discovered though, is that doing things for yourself is the new meta. Take care of your health. Take care of your mind. Most important... TAKE CARE OF YOUR HEART.
There is NOT one way for everyone, but I've found that family and true friends are just about the only real wealth in the world.
I'm aware this isn't game related, but I wanted it out there. It has been a day...

title: File 001 - Emergence
body: I know exactly why too, and it sucks there's nothing I can do about it.
Regardless, I need to get back up and keep moving forward.
Crashed out playing Undertale... no content made.
Have to update the web pages, this is still in its infancy.
Parables everywhere, the analogies overflow, and I'm just trying to figure it out and survive.
If you've read this far, maybe we can be friends...
Who ever heard of a friendly ghost? Insanity!
They exist. I exist. I'll keep working until something clicks.
